description: Fetches 1-10 public http(s) URLs server-side, one at a time, and stores each as a ready asset with no upload or finalize step. Media only: images, fonts, PDF, audio, video, dotLottie, and Rive; text, data, documents, and archives are refused. Images, fonts, and PDFs must parse as what they claim, hosts on private addresses are rejected, the upload kind and MIME rules apply, and each download is capped at 30 MiB (larger files must be uploaded directly). Each item may carry a `description` and, for images, a `category`. Name each item by `url`, or by `photo`: the number over a picture on contact sheets `webResearch.profile` or `webResearch.viewImage` showed you, which saves copying its long signed link. `assets` carries successes with CDN URLs and `sourceUrl`; `errors` carries failures typed `invalid_url`, `non_public_address`, `unreachable`, `too_large`, `unsupported_type`, `signature_expired`, or `unknown_photo` (a number you were not shown or that expired; look at the pictures again for current numbers). Import only assets you have the right to use.

items.description: Each item succeeds or fails on its own.

category.description: What the image is. Images only.

description.description: One sentence: subject, visible text, style, intended use.

filename.description: Stored filename; defaults to the URL path segment.

photo.description: Instead of `url`: the number over a picture on contact sheets `webResearch.profile` or `webResearch.viewImage` showed you.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the file to import.

name: websiteAssets_importFromUrl
title: Import assets from public URLs
